**Finding submitted: missing (insurance clause absent).**

- **Investigation:** The Agreement is a single-article MSA; searches for "insurance" and "coverage" returned no hits, confirming there is no insurance obligation on Kubient anywhere in the document.
- **Why it matters:** Kubient hosts the Auction Platform and, under §9(b)(iii) (p0035), collects, maintains and stores visitor information (data), and receives AP Confidential Information under §12. It also gives broad indemnities in §10(a) (p0047). Those obligations are financially unsupported without minimum coverage.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** New §14(j) inserted after p0073 requiring CGL USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, professional liability (E&O) USD 2M, cyber liability USD 5M covering Kubient's data handling, statutory workers' compensation, and certificates on request — held for the term plus one year. Fallback of E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M flagged in the comment for negotiation.
